falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200, breaking the August 2024 low of 4225 with volume exceeding 120% of 20-day average volume
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the actual August 2024 low held; breaking below it with expansion in volume confirms this is not a similar bottoming structure but rather a continuation lower, making the 'bottom' call wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days while S&P 500 fails to rally more than 1% on any of those days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 typically coincides with VIX spikes that mark capitulation; sustained VIX elevation without responsive buying indicates this is distribution not capitulation, invalidating the bottom signal and suggesting the 'HOLD' should have been 'SELL'

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield rises above 4.75% and the MOVE index (Treasury volatility) closes above 140 on the same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to August 2024 occurred during a rate-relief environment; simultaneous spike in yields and bond volatility would confirm a fundamentally different macro regime (inflation scare or Fed repricing), making historical pattern analog invalid and the UNKNOWN verdict a failure to recognize regime change

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
